privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.toggleLocation: Toggle location tracking for journey navigation
privacy.description: When enabled, the app can use GPS to detect your nearest station and track journey progress. Your raw location history is never stored — only the nearest station is determined in real time and discarded after use.

reporter.title: Reporter Stats
reporter.loadError: Failed to load reporter stats. Please try again later.

savedRoutes.title: Saved Routes
savedRoutes.emptyDescription: Save your frequent routes for quick access. After planning a route, tap the bookmark icon to save it.
savedRoutes.loadError: Failed to load saved routes. Please try again later.

alerts.freeBus: Free bus rides at {{count}} affected stations

messages.noServiceSignalling: No train service between {{from}} and {{to}} stations towards {{direction}} due to a signalling fault. Free bus rides are available at designated bus stops.
messages.slowerTrains: Trains are moving slower than usual between {{from}} and {{to}}. Please add {{minutes}} minutes to your journey.

normal.action: Your usual journey is on schedule.
normal.reason: Your estimated arrival is before your {{deadline}} deadline. No change is needed.

minor.reason: This five-minute impact still leaves you on time for {{deadline}}. No interruption is needed.

disrupted.action: Use the DTL alternative; arrive around {{arrival}} and avoid {{minutes}} minutes of delay.
disrupted.reason: The replayed EWL disruption puts your {{deadline}} arrival at risk. The supplied alternative is estimated to arrive before your deadline.

planned.action: Leave earlier and use the supplied alternative; arrive around {{arrival}}.
planned.reason: The planned works may affect your usual journey. Review the supplied alternative before departure.

inbox.empty: No journey notifications. Minor changes stay quiet.

push.title: Browser journey alerts
push.description: Optional alerts can reach this device when an important saved journey changes. Location history is never included.
push.disableSuccess: Browser journey alerts are off on this device.
push.blocked: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings.
push.failed: Browser alerts could not be configured. Check that the backend and VAPID key are available.
